blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Boxing promoter and lawyer Floriezyl Podot remains adamant about bringing a world title fight to Bohol following Thanongsak Simsri’s successful defense of his International Boxing Federation (IBF) world light flyweight title in Japan. In an interview with CDN Digital, Podot, the top honcho of PMI Bohol Boxing Stable and Promotions, said their offer for Simsri to defend his world title in Bohol remains on the table. Simsri scored an easy second-round technical knockout (TKO) win over Filipino Mark Vicelles on Sept. 26 in Shizuoka, Japan, successfully defending the belt for the second time since winning it from […]...
